status: candidate morphology reference; not a renderer configuration or a physical intrinsic-angle prior
tracer: HST F502N minus empirically scaled F547M
angle_convention: projected sky PA east of north; opening is full unless explicitly marked half

nominal_settings.profile: median over radial-bin medians of signed smoothed residual
nominal_settings.primary_selection: largest positive angular-profile sum among contiguous 15-160 degree sectors; no angle prior

analysis_sensitivity.meaning: range across explicit analysis choices, not statistical confidence or an intrinsic cone-angle distribution

existing_synthetic_comparison.interpretation: Within analysis-sensitivity ranges; not statistical validation or an inclination constraint

use: observed spatial morphology and radial dependence for comparison
do_not_use: pasted real pixels labeled as independent simulations
synthetic_use.evaluation: NGC 1068 becomes a calibration reference when used to tune generation; reserve other data for independent validation

no_flux_decomposition_reason: F187N has no matched near-IR continuum subtraction in this analysis; optical sectors only constrain candidate spatial support
